Hi, @.#$b#I'm just... sitting enjoying the weather. Nothing to see here.$s"/pause 1000/quickQuestion ...#Is something wrong? You seem upset.#Well, I'll leave you to it.(break)speak {{ModId}}_Ryden "No! I mean, doesn't everyone like to sit on a rock and brood every once in a while?$12#$b#...Fine. You caught me.$7#$b#It's just family stuff. I mean - daddy issues. You know how it is.$12"(break)move farmer 1 0 0\move farmer 0 -3 0\speak {{ModId}}_Ryden "Wait.$s"\faceDirection farmer 3\speak {{ModId}}_Ryden "Don't go. Not yet.$11"\move farmer 0 3 3\move farmer -1 0 3/playMusic echos/speak {{ModId}}_Ryden "The truth is, me and my dad got into a pretty bad fight about me spending so much time away lately.$12#$b#It was about that at first, at least... but then he started talking about how I'm dishonoring the family with how I live my life.$12#$b#When I was younger, I would come to this pier on rainy days and watch for a human boy that would come by.$s#$b#The way his hair clung to his face, the way his eyes seemed to glimmer in the light... I couldn't get enough.$l#$b#I hated myself for it.$s#$b#Not the "boy" part, mind you! Merfolk come in "all colors of the coral", as we say.#$b#I had simply never found myself attracted to something so... legged.#$b#Finally, my dad asked me what had gotten me so head over heels lately. I figured if I told him it was a boy and conveniently left out the human part, he wouldn't be mad.$s#$b#Turns out my dad is more traditional than I thought.$7#$b#He started going on and on about how "unbecoming" it is of me to be messing around with other mermen, and that if I don't produce an heir, my mother would be rolling in her grave.$s#$b#Which is ridiculous! His kingdom was completely torn apart and he cares about the optics of a gay relationship?!$a#$b#If he was actually a half decent dad, he'd just leave me alone!$a#$b#Even if I might not produce an heir...$12"/playMusic none/pause 1500/speak {{ModId}}_Ryden "Even if he wishes I wasn't his son.$7#$b#...$s#$b#...$15"/animate {{ModId}}_Ryden false false 350 0 25 26 25 26 25 26 25 26 25 26 25 26 25 26 27 29 30 31 32/pause 5000/speak {{ModId}}_Ryden "Ever since that day, I've been terrified to tell him that I love humans, too. I just don't know how he'd react.$14#$b#And yeah, I know it always seems like I'm confident and I don't care what other people think, but honestly... I want people to like me.$13#$b#I want my dad to love me.$13#$b#Sometimes I think it would be easier to just be the son he wants, but...$13"/quickQuestion I'm not sure I'd be happy that way.#Living authentically is hard, but pretending to be someone you're not is even harder.#It would definitely be easier...#Your dad sounds like he sucks.(break)speak {{ModId}}_Ryden "*sniff*...$13#$b#Yeah. You're right.$14#$b#That was very poetic of you, @. ...Thank you.$14#$b#It's time for me to get off this stupid rock.$14"(break)speak {{ModId}}_Ryden "I know... no more fights, no more feeling like I've failed as a son...$11#$b#...No. That's not right.$7#$b#I'm not gonna let someone bully the fabulous out of me. Even if he is my dad.$s#$b#Plus... I think the joy I get from being myself is greater than the pain of being rejected.$11#$b#Thank you for letting me be myself around you, @.#$b#It's time for me to get off this stupid rock."(break)speak {{ModId}}_Ryden "...$13#$b#...Pffhahaha!$16#$b#You know what - he DOES suck, huh?$14#$b#And I don't let sucky people tell me what to do.$16#$b#You really know how to cheer me up. Thank you, @.$14#$b#It's time for me to get off this stupid rock.$14"/globalFade 0.007/viewport -1000 -1000/playMusic ocean/pause 2000/playSound pullItemFromWater/pause 500/playSound slosh/pause 500/playSound slosh/pause 500/playSound pullItemFromWater/warp farmer 13 27/warp {{ModId}}_Ryden 11 27/showFrame {{ModId}}_Ryden 0/faceDirection {{ModId}}_Ryden 1/positionOffset {{ModId}}_Ryden 0 -24/fade/viewport 10 26 clamp/pause 2000/speak {{ModId}}_Ryden "I'm such a teenager sometimes, aren't I?"/pause 500/speak {{ModId}}_Ryden "@...you're one of my closest friends.#$b#And I won't let anyone get in the way of our friendship. No matter what."/pause 5000/end
